summary: Upload committed Git state to selected twin destinations, or download only after unanimous agreement among an explicit number of configured twin sources.

canonical_verbs.download: retrieve and verify a branch from multiple independent sources

upload.fractional_semantics: floor(value) guaranteed whole copies plus probability fractional(value) of one additional whole copy

download.selection: first N configured twin source URLs in configured order
download.consensus: all selected source branch SHAs must be identical
download.integration: fast-forward only after consensus; otherwise halt without branch modification
